title: The Treatise of Applied Strength
summary: A treatise that turns plain bodily force into driving palm work and a steady rhythm of crushing blows.

title: Handbook of the Crushing Hold
summary: A handbook of grips and pins that end in a clasp strong enough to break a guard or hold a body down.

title: The Weight-Bearing Course
summary: A course in fighting while heavily laden and in carrying others out of danger on legs and back hardened by qi.

title: A Course in Rending Force
summary: A short course on tearing and wrenching force that pulls apart a guard and the grip behind it.

title: The Heavy Hand Canon
summary: A canon that grows the heavy hand into a full weapon of falling fists and clearing out the ache of overwork.

title: Workbook of the Driving Shoulder
summary: A workbook on charging with the shoulder and the elbow so that the whole frame becomes a ram.

title: Treatise on the Unyielding Frame
summary: A treatise on holding the body immovable under blows and rising from the stand into a strike.

title: The Strength of Both Hands Course
summary: A course that teaches both hands to strike and seize and press as one so that no force is wasted.
